name: fairflow
description: Fairflow — commerce infrastructure for South African merchants

scripts.start: cd packages/shadow-index && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.demo:record: node scripts/check-servers.mjs && npm run demo:playwright && node scripts/copy-demo-video.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix packages/shadow-index && npm run lint --prefix packages/auth-portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run type-check --prefix packages/shadow-index && npm exec --prefix packages/auth-portal -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/shadow-index -- --run && npm test --prefix packages/auth-portal
